analyst_view.overall: Early view: a Seville derby with Betis 4th, eight points clear of Luis García Plaza's 6th-placed Sevilla, after a 2-0 win at Elche built on set pieces. Sevilla have struggled to score, drawing 0-0 with Alavés after Rubén Vargas missed a penalty, and they may be without Peque (hamstring) and Kike Salas, who went off injured. Betis then go to Slovan Bratislava in the Champions League on Tuesday, with Cucho Hernández working back from a calf injury.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals. Sevilla have been blunt (García Plaza publicly asked his strikers for more goals before the Alavés game, which still ended 0-0), and Betis are without Cucho Hernández. Derbies tend to be stop-start, so I expect two goals or fewer.

corners.text: The site expects 9.0 corners. Betis won eight corners at Elche and worked set pieces all week, with Bartra scoring from one; Antony's habit of shooting from range also brings blocks and deflections. Sevilla took five against Alavés with 60% of the ball.

cards.text: The model already has 7.0 cards, well above a normal game, because this is a derby. Sevilla had Manu Bueno sent off at Getafe two games ago, while Betis took no yellows at Elche. I'd hold at around seven until the referee is named.

shots.text: The site expects 27.4 shots. Betis had 18 at Elche, but derbies are broken up by fouls and Sevilla's attack lacks Peque's spark. I see the total in the low to mid 20s rather than above 27.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.2 on target. Betis' volume does not always reach the target (Antony went more than 30 league shots without a goal into late October), and Sevilla missed the target repeatedly against Alavés. Seven or eight is more likely.
